title: A .env refusal fires after compose.yaml is already on the VPS: _deploy_docker (and the template/git paths) write compose.yaml before _write_env_files formats the .env, so a refused line (NUL, non-UTF-8, and since W-aa69894d a bad key, e.g. one read back from a broken VPS line) leaves the new compose beside the old .env until the next up.
